proposed_from.topic: Sharp cycle-flow bounds for coupled comparison-cohort anticipation. In finite staggered adoption under PT-All, let pre-adoption means satisfy mu_ht=alpha_h+lambda_t+a_ht, with a_ht zero outside known anticipation horizons and bounded inside them. Characterize the sharp joint fiber by the fundamental cycles of the cohort-time graph; prove a causal completion theorem for every compatible mean vector; give necessary and sufficient variation-independence and box-endpoint exactness frontiers; compute arbitrary ATT-aggregate endpoints using interval-tension feasibility and min-cost circulation; and construct finite-sample honest outer confidence sets by jointly optimizing simultaneous bounded-mean bands. The consumer is the Callaway-Sant'Anna not-yet-treated risk-set workflow for announced staggered policies, including the Indonesian anti-cheating rollout. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Orienting the cohort-time graph gives an incidence matrix B and a cycle matrix C with ker(C)=im(B^T), so compatibility reduces to C_U a_U=C mu after clean coordinates are fixed. The presolver derived the affine dimension, component gauges, interval-tension feasibility certificate, and a min-cost-transshipment dual for every linear support function. It also derived that full primitive-box variation independence holds exactly when every positive-width uncertain edge is a bridge, subject to fixed-cycle compatibility. The checked three-cohort witness forces a_43-a_53=1/2 and tightens the equal-weight bias range from [-1,1] to [-3/4,3/4]. Disconnected graphs, zero-width edges, forests, infeasible means, arbitrary ATT weights, and active-face changes produced no counterexample; Fenaroli's staggered analysis leaves anticipatory not-yet-treated comparisons open. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the causal sharpness/completion lemma embedding every cycle-compatible mean vector in one announced-policy staggered-adoption potential-outcome law that simultaneously supports all overlapping risk-set estimands and maintained outcome bounds. EARLY KILL TEST: Exhaustively enumerate bipartite graphs through three cohorts by three periods, including disconnected and zero-width cases, and compare direct rational-LP feasibility and support values with the negative-cycle and circulation formulations; any mismatch stops or pivots the run.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: Callaway and Sant'Anna point-identify not-yet-treated risk-set effects by moving outside a known anticipation horizon. Fenaroli's August 5, 2026 revision derives staggered bounds with never-treated controls; Section 4.2 observes that not-yet-treated comparisons require accounting for anticipation in the comparison group but does not characterize the joint restrictions produced by their reuse across risk sets. The proposed kernel addresses that narrower gap using one deterministic, known announcement-and-implementation path for each cohort, a proposal-specific all-cohort additive mean restriction for the path with neither announcement nor implementation, and edgewise sensitivity intervals for announcement-to-implementation responses that are distinct from Fenaroli's cohort-level increment bounds. The resulting interval-constrained fundamental-cycle fiber has positive-width coordinates that are variation independent if and only if they are bridges, nominal endpoint attainability certified by negative cycles, and arbitrary signed ATT support values given by min-cost transshipment. Torgovitsky and Piccininni show why the remaining full-law completion over explicitly indexed paths cannot be replaced by mean-level LP attainability; the core therefore exposes that construction as its load-bearing open question.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the bounded anticipation fiber by fundamental cycles, derive bridge and endpoint if-and-only-if frontiers and circulation support functions, and lift every bounded feasible mean vector to one announcement-indexed causal law.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Fenaroli's cohortwise Cartesian-product step by a common incidence-potential equation for every reused comparison cell, then perform a full-law extension instead of assuming attainability.
seed_details.destination_search: Targeted searches for staggered anticipation, not-yet-treated controls, cycle restrictions, and minimum-cost circulation found no occupied target-method pair; Fenaroli's August 2026 Conclusion explicitly leaves anticipatory not-yet-treated comparisons open.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from two-way fixed-effect algebra plus arbitrary counterfactual assignment.
seed_details.rebuttal: The algebra gives only mean compatibility; bounded full-law completion, simultaneous realization of overlapping risk-set effects, bridge necessity, endpoint deletion, and the transshipment dual are additional claims. The core keeps completion explicitly open.

seed_details.kernel: Propagate simultaneous bounded-mean concentration through the entire feasible cycle region to obtain finite-sample outer coverage without differentiating or bootstrapping endpoint maps.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Callaway--Sant'Anna's asymptotic linear representation and multiplier bootstrap by one joint finite-sample event for primitive means, followed by set-valued optimization.
seed_details.destination_search: Fang--Liebl provides asymptotic functional bands, Fenaroli reports Bayesian credible bands, and Voronin studies asymptotic LP-value inference; none supplies finite-sample coverage of this coupled region.
seed_details.red_team: A union bound followed by projection is mechanically conservative and therefore too routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage is elementary once the correct causal fiber exists, but the computable joint optimization, zero-count handling, infeasible fibers, and changing active faces make it a useful inference rung rather than the standalone kernel.

seed_details.kernel: Choose comparison-risk-set edges to minimize worst-case aggregate ATT width subject to overlap and causal connectivity, with a cut or matroid optimality certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Make the Callaway--Sant'Anna comparison set a decision variable before constructing the ATT contrast.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches located fixed choices between never- and not-yet-treated controls and corrections using known-clean groups, but no cycle-aware optimal risk-set selection theorem.
seed_details.red_team: This is merely specification search that rewards dropping inconvenient cohorts.
seed_details.rebuttal: A valid version must impose ex ante admissibility and deliver an observable approximation or optimality certificate; without that discipline the seed would be dropped.

seed_details.kernel: Prove that primitive-box variation independence holds exactly when every positive-width uncertain edge is a bridge, subject to fixed-cycle compatibility.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace independent maximization of each anticipation coordinate by surjectivity of the cycle-constrained projection onto its marginal boxes.
seed_details.destination_search: Dawid supplies the abstract product-range definition, but no DiD paper gives the bridge criterion.
seed_details.red_team: This is a textbook property of cycle spaces.
seed_details.rebuttal: The graph fact is elementary, but identifying the correct econometric parameter map and fixed-coordinate compatibility condition is new; alone it is subfield-tier.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize attainment of every nominal anticipation-box endpoint by a pinned interval-tension system and an equivalent negative-cycle certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After obtaining the joint fiber, pin one coordinate before optimizing rather than reading its marginal endpoint from the primitive box.
seed_details.destination_search: No staggered-anticipation source located a coordinatewise endpoint frontier under shared comparison cohorts.
seed_details.red_team: Endpoint testing is just resolving one linear program per coordinate.
seed_details.rebuttal: The negative-cycle equivalence supplies an exact graph certificate and exposes when published-style nominal endpoints are impossible, but it is supporting rather than standalone field-tier content.

seed_details.kernel: Map every signed group-time ATT aggregation to node demands and prove that its sharp endpoints equal minimum-cost transshipment values.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace coordinatewise box support after coefficient pooling by dualization of interval tensions through the cohort-time incidence matrix.
seed_details.destination_search: Generic flow and stochastic-LP papers occupy the mathematical ingredients, but targeted searches found no DiD derivation connecting ATT weights to flow balances.
seed_details.red_team: Strong LP duality makes the claimed reduction immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Duality alone does not identify the correct augmented tensions, node demands, component gauges, bounded-outcome edges, feasibility certificate, or causal attainment.

seed_details.kernel: Define the smallest common anticipation radius at which a signed ATT conclusion changes and express it as a parametric minimum-cost-flow breakpoint.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Fenaroli's cohortwise sensitivity frontier with a parametric circulation whose optimal face changes at graph-determined breakpoints.
seed_details.destination_search: Breakdown-frontier papers and Fenaroli treat separable or never-treated settings; no cycle-coupled critical-radius formula was found.
seed_details.red_team: This is a reparameterization of the endpoint function by a scalar sensitivity radius.
seed_details.rebuttal: It becomes nontrivial only if the breakpoint admits a cut certificate and comparative statics; without those it would collapse to relabeling.

seed_details.kernel: Partially identify true-switcher effects when uncertain anticipation timing couples the same comparison cohorts across several missclassification-corrected contrasts.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace known timing and unaffected-group selection in the corrected estimator by a bounded latent timing vector constrained jointly across cohorts.
seed_details.destination_search: Augustin--Gutknecht--Liu identifies under timing knowledge; no exact coupled bounded-timing fiber was located.
seed_details.red_team: This only weakens their timing assumption and necessarily gives an uninformative generic LP.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed survives only if treatment-timing structure yields graph-reducible nontrivial bounds; it is less direct than the mean-anticipation kernel.

seed_details.kernel: Replace mean distortions by bounded pre-adoption quantile transports and seek a coupled extremal-transport representation across staggered risk sets.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Gong's scalar mixture and quantile envelope by a common coupling across every reuse of a future-treated cohort.
seed_details.destination_search: Adjacent work covers two-period quantile anticipation and generic optimal transport, but no tractable staggered joint coupling was found.
seed_details.red_team: Shared quantiles do not induce linear cycle restrictions, so the proposed graph method may disappear.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is unresolved and materially threatens feasibility; this seed was dropped rather than padded into the shortlist.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 4–6 / Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Causal sharpness, transshipment endpoints, and finite-sample coverage are conditional on proving the exhaustive common-full-law completion property; that property is posed as an actual open construction problem, not assumed as an answer.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Theorems 4–6 are sharp only conditional on a positive resolution of Open-ended Question 1; a negative resolution must instead supply the additional compatibility restriction and counterexample requested there.
